PF2E-D20.Title: PF2e d20 Session Tracker
PF2E-D20.Settings.Timezone.Name: World timezone
PF2E-D20.Settings.Timezone.Hint: IANA timezone used to group rolls into evenings, e.g. America/Chicago. Every client buckets identically.
PF2E-D20.Settings.BoundaryHour.Name: Evening boundary hour
PF2E-D20.Settings.BoundaryHour.Hint: Rolls before this hour (world timezone) belong to the previous evening. Default 6 = a game running past midnight stays one session.
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureEnabled.Name: Capture rolls
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureEnabled.Hint: Turn off while prepping or testing between sessions so stray rolls are not recorded.
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureRawRolls.Name: Count raw d20 rolls
PF2E-D20.Settings.CaptureRawRolls.Hint: Include /r 1d20 style rolls and Dice Tray rolls that carry no PF2e check context.
PF2E-D20.Settings.MinRollsToList.Name: Minimum dice to list an evening
PF2E-D20.Settings.MinRollsToList.Hint: Evenings with fewer dice are hidden from the session picker unless 'show all' is chosen.
PF2E-D20.Settings.PlayerAccess.Name: Player access
PF2E-D20.Settings.PlayerAccess.Hint: What players may open. Secret rolls are always filtered per the blind roll policy.
PF2E-D20.Settings.BlindPolicy.Name: Blind and secret rolls in player views
PF2E-D20.Settings.BlindPolicy.Hint: Hide for the current evening (default): a secret Stealth natural cannot be inferred until the evening is over.
PF2E-D20.Settings.McIterations.Name: Monte Carlo iterations
PF2E-D20.Settings.McIterations.Hint: Simulated fair evenings used for the 'one in N nights' labels on the fun tab.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.NoRolls: No d20 rolls recorded for this evening yet.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.ThinSample: Fewer than 15 dice: luck z is not meaningful yet.
PF2E-D20.Tonight.Help: Luck is the natural die only, measured against a fair d20 (mean 10.5). |z| under 1 is noise, 1–2 is noticeably hot or cold, over 2 is a genuinely blessed or cursed evening (about a 1 in 20 chance under a fair die). This measures the dice, not the player.
PF2E-D20.Source.Preview: Preview mode: computed from the chat log on this client (nothing stored yet).
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ToggleExclude: Exclude from / include in the lists
PF2E-D20.Sessions.DeleteConfirm: Delete every recorded die for {label}? The chat log is not touched; only tonight's evening can be re-caught from chat.
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ResetConfirm1: Delete the whole d20 Session Log journal and every recorded evening?
PF2E-D20.Sessions.ResetConfirm2: This cannot be undone. Past evenings cannot be rebuilt from chat in this version. Really delete everything?
PF2E-D20.Sessions.CatchUpHint: Scan tonight's chat messages for dice the live capture missed (after a reload or a server restart).
